decisions.reason: Pins node.exe PID 42432 (dsh web host) as the koffi.node loader and explains the mapped native binary stays locked until that process exits, so npm's copyfile fails with EBUSY.
Explains a browser refresh only reloads the SPA while the host keeps the lock; gives the ordered stop → verify PIDs gone → pinned install → restart sequence.
Explains a bare package name follows latest=0.1.1-rc.2 (alpha holds alpha.5) and overwrites the newer installed alpha.4 — a silent downgrade, not version preservation.
Provides npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 plus the pinned TUI install after stopping the host, verifies dsh --version prints alpha.5, restarts; @alpha only as a mutable alternative.

Advises pinning the exact tested core (and plugin) versions in README install commands, splitting host upgrade from plugin install, and warning that bare names follow latest over an installed prerelease.
